info.title: Albireo Community Edition local interface
info.description:
The interface of the Albireo service, served on https://localhost (port 8443 unless changed in the tray). The routes under /v1 follow the OpenAI interface, so that its client libraries work with base_url https://localhost:8443/v1 and any API key. The functions albireo-general, albireo-code and albireo-security name the models activated in the tray, albireo-background the model that comes with Albireo, which the web application uses for its work in the background, and albireo-embedding the embedding model of the search in documents.

The administration routes require the token of the data folder of the service (admin.token) in the X-Albireo-Admin header.

Requests carry JSON bodies of 64 MB and 524,288 values at most, with their length: a body without length is refused with 411, a longer one with 413, another type with 415. GET, HEAD, DELETE and OPTIONS take no body (400). An answer being written whose model has no memory left for its keys and values ends with the error code out_of_memory.

post.summary: Imports a signed offline bundle, or the content of the import folder
post.description: For a computer without network: a memory card or a disk brought to the machine. The service reads with its own rights, so that it accepts two kinds of paths: a signed offline bundle on a local drive (a folder whose catalog.json or feed.json bears the signature of Albireo, as tools/make_offline_bundle.py prepares it), of which it reads only the signed files, the models the signed catalog lists, by their names, sizes and hashes, and the installer the signed feed names; and a folder or a file of the import folder of the data folder. Every file is read through no link. A model file of the user is sent through /albireo/v1/models/upload. An older catalog never replaces a newer one, a model installed already is listed under already, and the update is installed at the next start of the service.

content.description: Text, or a list of parts: text parts, and for a model that reads images (inputs of /v1/models) image_url parts, 16 images per request at most.

reasoning_content.description: Reasoning of an earlier assistant message.

tool_call_id.description: For a tool message: the call it answers.

url.description: A PNG or JPEG file as a data URL, data:image/png;base64,... or data:image/jpeg;base64,...; the service fetches no address (code invalid_image_url), reads no other format (invalid_image_format), and refuses more than 20 MB, 8192 pixels on a side or 40 megapixels.

detail.description: The tokens an image takes at most: for Qwen3-VL 256, 576 or 1024 tokens of 32 pixels square; for a LLaVA-NeXT model (EuroVLM) the whole image and 1, 2 or 4 tiles of 384 pixels.

ContentPart.description: A part of the content of a message. A model that reads text only refuses the images (code image_input_not_supported), and a request carries 16 images at most (too_many_images).

index.description: Position of the call, in the chunks of a stream.

max_tokens.description: Tokens to generate at most; by default up to the end of the context.

top_k.description: Keeps the k most likely tokens, among which top_p and min_p then choose; 0 sets no limit, and the 1024 most likely tokens are kept. Without it, 40, or 20 for a model of the ChatML format that reasons. A value outside 0 to 1024 is refused (400). Without effect at temperature 0, which takes the most likely token.

logit_bias.description: Bias added to the logits of tokens, keyed by token identifiers of the vocabulary of the model; another key is refused.

model.description: A model identifier, a function (albireo-general, albireo-code, albireo-security), albireo-background or auto. A function without a model of its own is served by the general model; albireo-background, the work done in the background (titles, summaries, memory), by the model that comes with Albireo, else the general one.

reasoning.description: Enables or disables the reasoning of the models that support both modes. The reasoning streams in reasoning_content.

ChatCompletionChunk.description: One event of a stream (text/event-stream), as 'data: <chunk>' lines ended by 'data: [DONE]'.

model.description: albireo-embedding, auto, or the identifier of an active embedding model.

input.description: A text, a list of texts, or token lists.

encoding_format.description: base64: the little-endian float32 values of each vector.

dimensions.description: Keeps the leading dimensions of each vector, normalized again, for the models trained to keep their meaning when shortened (Qwen3 Embedding: 32 to 1024).

input: The service runs on this computer.

embedding.description: Unit vector: numbers, or a base64 string.

inputs.description: What the model reads, text and images; an alias gives those of its model.

publisher.description: The company that made the model, empty when unknown.

Settings.description: Settings the tray may change; a change of port, engine or memory restarts the service.

v2ram.description: Extended device memory of the graphics engines.

v2ram_max_mb.description: Limit of the extended memory, 0 for automatic.

device_mb.description: Memory of the device for the copies of the weights of the models, in megabytes, 0 for automatic.

offline.description: No access to the network: the catalog, the models and the updates come from imports, and the service opens no connection.

proxy.description: Proxy of the downloads: empty for the proxy of the system, none for a direct connection, or http://[user:password@]host:port.  The settings give the password as ********; that value sent back keeps the stored password when the user, the host and the port stay the same, and is refused (code proxy_password) otherwise.

starting.description: True while the engines are being described.

reason.description: Why the engine cannot run here, in English.

reason_code.description: The code of the reason: isa_avx2, isa_avx_vnni, isa_avx512, no_nvidia_driver, old_nvidia_driver, no_nvidia_card, old_nvidia_card, no_intel_device, intel_device_unusable, library_failed, probe_timeout.

missing.description: For an engine that runs: why its runtime left out the other devices it looks for, such as the message of a plugin of OpenVINO.

options.description: The choices of engine and device.

names.description: The names of the devices of the choice.

measure.description: The last measure of the choice.

current.description: The key of the choice in use.

UpdateState.description: The updates: their state, the versions, the notes by language, and an error with its code and its values, which the tray translates.

code.description: update_check {e}, update_record {version}, update_feed_missing {version}, update_feed_missing_folder {folder}, update_signature {file}, update_feed_mismatch {file, version}, update_outside {file}, update_installer_mismatch {version}, update_feed_invalid, update_download {e}, update_not_ready, update_invalid {version}, update_start {code}, update_package_manager, stopping.

Refusal.description: A refused operation, with the code of its reason and its values.
